name: zrndr_draw_flat_queued
description: zRndr_DrawFlatQueued renders a queued flat/textured polygon through the software rasterizer span path.
known_limits: Binary Ninja still reports the known x87 flag-lift limitation at 0x493eea.

The current VC5SP3 function-byte comparison for 0x493df0 fails with 3111 unmasked bytes, 160 relocation-masked bytes, and 13 trimmed VC NOPs; tier S remains deferred to the coherent zRndr draw/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly and decompilation for 0x493df0 validate the queued polygon path: perspective texture/depth gradient setup, fixed ScanConvertEdge table construction, mip variant selection, active texture/palette/alpha globals, direct secondary span-list dispatch, and selected queued span operation dispatch.
The native smoke verifies span-list invocation, queued span dispatch, active texture/alpha-map/palette globals, selected span callback, framebuffer destination bounds, and the fixed V-shift contract.
VC5SP3 data-symbol targets pass with zero unmasked data-byte mismatches for the active texture globals: zrndr_draw_flat_queued_active_texture_data and zrndr_draw_flat_queued_active_texture_data_tail.

Shared raster/span globals are covered by current zero-mismatch targets zrndr_draw_flat_immediate_data, zrndr_draw_flat_immediate_data_b, zrndr_span_selector_dispatch_data_a, and zrndr_span_selector_dispatch_data_a_tail.
